description: One user tool, in `./.dive/tools/` or `~/.config/dive/tools/`, called as `user__<name>`. A file in a tools directory's `builtin/` subdirectory replaces the built-in tool it names instead.

oneOf.description: Runs a command. stdout becomes the result; a non-zero exit, a timeout or unparseable JSON is a tool error. Exec tools run arbitrary code, by design.

examples.description: Open pull requests in the current repository, newest first.
examples.name: open_prs

description.description: Markdown saying what the value is and where to get it, links included. Shown wherever the secret is asked for, and by `dive secret list`.

value.description: The value, exactly as the plain string form takes it.

env.description: Extra environment variables. Each value is a string, or `{value, description}` to say what a secret is and where to get it. Values expand `${VAR}` from Dive's environment or, when it's unset or empty there, from the OS credential store (the project's value first, then the global one). `${VAR:-default}` falls back to the default when neither has a value; a `${VAR}` with no default is a secret the tool needs. A tool from an installed pack also gets `DIVE_PACK_DIR`, the absolute path of the pack's installed directory, so it can run scripts and binaries the pack ships.

output.description: `json` parses stdout as JSON; `text` returns it as `{text}`.

timeout_secs.description: Seconds before the process is killed.

oneOf.title: exec

oneOf.description: One model call. The result is `{text}`, or validated JSON when `output_schema` is set.

examples.description: Summarizes text into a gist and three keywords.
examples.name: summarize
examples.prompt: Summarize into one sentence and three keywords: {{input.text}}

caller_model.description: Let the call's `model` input pick the role.

model.description: The model role that runs the call, standard or custom.

prompt.description: The message to send, as a template over `{{input.*}}`.

oneOf.title: prompt

oneOf.description: Builds a value in a new JSON shape from the input, with no process and no model call. Leaf strings are templates; a leaf that is exactly one template keeps the value's type.

examples.description: Turns a pull request into a table row.
examples.name: pr_summary_row

caller_shape.description: Take `shape` from the call's input instead.

shape.description: The output shape, as a JSON tree whose leaf strings are templates over `{{input.*}}`.

oneOf.title: reshape

oneOf.description: Asks a decision model typed questions about the same state, each answered independently. The result maps each question name to its answer.

examples.description: Routes a support ticket and checks whether it is urgent.
examples.name: triage

team.instructions: Which team should handle this ticket?

caller_model.description: Let the call's `model` input pick the role.

caller_questions.description: Take `questions` from the call's input instead.

model.description: A decision model role. A chat role fails the call.

questions.description: Question name to question. Each has a `type` (`likelihood`, `choice` or `score`), `instructions`, and `criteria` for that type.

state.description: The data to judge, as a template tree over `{{input.*}}`. Omitted, the call's `state` input is used.

oneOf.title: decision

description.description: What the tool does and returns. Agents and the plan drafter read it when choosing tools.

input_schema.description: JSON Schema for the input, validated before the tool runs. Templates reference it as `{{input.<field>}}`.

kind.description: What the tool runs. Each kind takes its own fields, listed below.

name.description: Letters, digits, `_` and `-`. The tool is called as `user__<name>`.

output_schema.description: JSON Schema for the output. A `prompt` tool enforces it as structured output; for every kind it tells drafters what the tool returns.

read_only.description: Marks the tool as free of side effects. `reshape` and `decision` tools are read-only by default.

version.description: The file version the document is written in. Omitted means 1; `dive tool migrate` brings a file to the current version.
